subject: microbiology
title: Bacillus cereus Food Poisoning and Listeria monocytogenes

steps.tx: **Bacillus cereus food poisoning** comes in two toxin syndromes: emetic (cereulide preformed in starchy foods, vomiting in 0.5 to 6 hours, mitochondrial toxin rarely fulminant hepatic) and diarrhoeal (enterotoxins HBL, NHE, CytK made in the gut, watery diarrhoea 8 to 16 hours after meats and sauces). Both self limit usually, incubation splits them at interview.
steps.say: Rice and hours vomit, meat and half a day purge: cereus syndromes split by clock.

right.title: Diarrhoeal syndrome
points: 8 to 16 hours, watery diarrhoea and cramps

steps.tx: **Cereulide** is a cyclic depsipeptide potassium ionophore made by ces gene strains in food, resistant to heat, acid and proteases, occasionally causing fulminant liver failure in young patients after reheated pasta and rice. Its severity tail explains why emetic cereus is not always trivial.
steps.say: Cereulide survives stomach and stove, and rarely takes a liver with it.

left.title: Cereulide facts
points: Made only by emetic lineage strains
Stable to 121 degrees traditions, pH extremes

right.title: Prevention
points: Reheat once, steaming hot, eat immediately
Discard room temperature starches after hours

steps.tx: **Listeria monocytogenes** is a small gram positive rod, catalase positive, beta haemolytic weakly, tumbling at room temperature (next lesson), growing at refrigerator temperatures in soft cheeses, deli meats and unpasteurised milk, intracellular (listeriolysin O, actin rockets), terrorising pregnancy, neonates and cell mediated immunodeficiency.
steps.say: Cold growing, cell invading, placenta crossing: Listeria owns the immunocompromised refrigerator.

left.title: Organism portrait
points: Weak beta haemolysis, CAMP like synergy

right.title: Virulence kit
points: ActA actin rockets cell to cell

steps.tx: **Listeriosis syndromes** divide by host: healthy gastroenteritis outbreaks, pregnancy third trimester bacteraemia with fetal loss, neonatal granulomatosis infantiseptica and meningitis, elderly and immunosuppressed meningitis and rhombencephalitis, endocarditis rare. Ampicillin (gentamicin debated) is therapy's core, cephalosporins intrinsically useless, a prescribing trap.
steps.say: Cephalosporins never cover Listeria; ampicillin is the meningitis addition that saves it.

left.title: Host syndromes
points: Pregnancy: flu like bacteraemia, abortion, stillbirth
Neonate: early sepsis and late meningitis

right.title: Therapy logic
points: Empiric meningitis over 50 and pregnant adds ampicillin

steps.tx: **Food safety for listeriosis** targets ready to eat refrigeration: cook deli meats for pregnant patients in some guidelines, avoid unpasteurised soft cheeses, respect shelf lives (growth slow but real), factory environmental control because Listeria persists in drains and slicers in cold wet biofilms.
steps.say: Refrigeration slows everything except Listeria's ambitions; shelf life is its growth chart.

left.title: Risk foods
points: Deli meats and hot dogs unreheated

right.title: Control points
points: Use by dates respected cold chain

steps.tx: **Listeria bench identity** (small rods in blood and CSF, gram variable ghosts, tumbling in wet mount at 25 degrees, umbrella in semisolid, cold enrichment heritage, black on Oxford and PALCAM selective agars by aesculin) protects it from dismissal as diphtheroid contaminant, its commonest laboratory death.
steps.say: A diphtheroid in CSF that tumbles is Listeria until proven otherwise.

right.title: Dismissal traps
points: Reported as diphtheroids in blood cultures
Gram decolorises to gram negative mimicry

steps.tx: **Erysipelothrix rhusiopathiae** joins gram positive rod differentials (erysipeloid fish and meat handler hand lesions, endocarditis), slender rods, hydrogen sulfide in TSI, penicillin susceptible and vancomycin resistant intrinsically, a therapy booby trap beside Listeria in occupational histories. Handlers frequently confuse it with Bacillus cereus because both are spore forming rods from the environment, until motility, sulfide and clinical setting are examined together.
steps.say: Fish handler's painful finger plus vancomycin resistance names Erysipelothrix.

steps.tx: **Cereus eye and wound disease** deserve the final contrast: post traumatic Bacillus endophthalmitis destroys eyes in hours (motile Bacillus in vitreous, aggressive surgery plus intravitreal therapy), catheter bacteraemia in immunocompromised, food poisoning a world away in severity from the same species.
steps.say: Same species, three planets: rice bowl trivial, vitreous catastrophic.

left.title: Eye emergency
points: Penetrating trauma with soil or metal
Vitrectomy and intravitreal vancomycin clindamycin traditions
